records.question: According to Table 1, which CRF configuration has the highest recall, and how does that recall compare with the plain LSTM?
records.answer:
Among the CRF configurations in Table 1, CRF n-grams + language features has the highest recall at 55.3.
The plain LSTM has a recall of 58.7, which is higher than the best CRF configuration's recall of 55.3.

| Classifier and features         |   Accuracy |   Precision |   Recall |   F-score |
|---------------------------------|------------|-------------|----------|-----------|
| CRF n-grams                     |       61.8 |        56.8 |     45.1 |      50.2 |
| CRF language features           |       67.8 |        67.5 |     47.8 |      56.0 |
| CRF n-grams + language features |       65.9 |        61.2 |     55.3 |      58.1 |
| LSTM                            |       63.1 |        56.7 |     58.7 |      57.6 |
| LSTM + high level features      |       70.0 |        66.7 |     59.4 |      62.9 |
